rapport_notes: Warm and accommodating, stayed helpful under real time pressure (last-minute move, uncertain details).

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concerns. It's a one bedroom apartment but... (no concern to dig into — N/A per rubric)
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: if it takes less than what you think it should be then we pay for however long the movers are doing their work / Exactly, ma'am.
